protocol.input_policy: Compare actual raw sample/order and train/test transform fingerprints; common transform recipe does not imply identical stochastic crop realizations across historical pipelines.

protocol.measurement_scope: Recorder interval includes initialization, data loading, begin/train/end, evaluation and audits/checkpoint. Final W&B artifact upload/finish is excluded. GPU board energy excludes CPU/RAM/system power; FLOPs are partial supported-operator estimates.
protocol.historical_limits: Historical measurements have different dates/source snapshots/phase budgets. EASE CPU thread count was not recorded and stays unknown. RanPAC gets four fresh runs rather than reusing its overwritten historical train-transform metadata.
protocol.task1_limits: No task2 KD/old-branch interactions or long-term forgetting/growth are estimated. HiDe uses TII1+prompt1 and two statistics passes; one epoch is not equal compute.
